# Source and extraction record

**Original official PDF:** https://www.bog.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Summary-of-Economic-and-Financial-Data-September-2026.pdf
**Published:** 23 September 2026. **Printed table:** Table 11, Payment Systems Data, page 13.
**Window:** August 2025–August 2026 inclusive.
**Extracted values:** 13 monthly registered-account and active-account figures, monthly transaction counts, and transaction values. Values manually transcribed from official published table.
**Units:** accounts and transaction counts in millions; transaction values in billions of Ghana cedis.
**Definition:** active accounts transacted at least once in the 90 days prior to reporting.
**Caveat:** source values are rounded and data are subject to revision. This is not an API feed or second-release independent audit.
**Reproduce:** `py -3 stories/GILB-003/analysis/reproduce_gilb003.py`
